name: quality-v2-bag50k
note: v2 long-horizon quality protocol (U15/U16). The v1 protocol benchmarks/config.json and its results are frozen and separate. Policies are depth-one software policies whose decisions passed their own-reference RTL tests (P0-P7 core corpora, results/v2/raw/decisions). Development suites use seeds 10000-10019; the held-out suite uses seeds 20000-20099 and is run only after `bench-v2 MODE=freeze` recorded this file's hash.

pilot.purpose: wall time, memory and cap-hit estimates per policy on 20 development streams at a 10,000-piece cap

pilot50k.purpose: P0 and the strongest development policy at the 10,000 cap (P1: cap-hit 0.70 vs 0.40 for P0 in the pilot suite) to the full 50,000 cap before freezing the primary protocol

bag50k.purpose: primary study: six depth-one policies on 100 paired held-out seven-bag streams, cap 50,000 locked pieces

execution.resume: exact identity match of the checkpoint (protocol hash, policy, stream hash, cap, model closure) only
execution.failure_handling: a crash or missing result is a failed job to repair and resume; it is never a censoring event or a top-out; summaries reject incomplete paired sets

outcomes.event_time: T = successfully locked pieces before the first top-out decision; a game stopped at the cap C reports duration C with event_observed = false
outcomes.restricted_mean: mean(min(T, C)) over the paired streams; an estimate of the restricted mean to C, not of unbounded survival
outcomes.survival: discrete product-limit survival S(t) = P(T > t) with the cap and censoring marked; the median is reported only if S crosses 1/2 within [0, C), otherwise 'not reached by C'
outcomes.comparisons: every policy against the baseline (P0), paired by stream id

statistics.resampling_unit: stream id, jointly across compared policies (whole streams, never individual moves)
statistics.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the resampled mean paired difference
